info.name: Alpen API
info.description:
Alpen Wege API (generated by build_postman.py from the API's OpenAPI description).

**Use:** import this collection and `Alpen API local.postman_environment.json`, select the environment, run **profile / auth / Login admin** once, then any call. Tokens last only a few minutes; the collection keeps the newest one automatically (header `X-Access-Token`). If a call answers 401, log in again.

**URL:** `http://{{hostname}}:{{port}}/{{api_path}}/<app>/<resource>`. Folders: one per app (core, compendium, assets, explorer, profile, management), one per model inside.

**Variables:** `hostname`, `port`, `api_path` (= `api/v1`), `<who>_email` / `<who>_password` for admin, editor, viewer, guest, `new_user_password`, and `access_token`. Create calls save ids in variables such as `country_id`, `region_id`, `poi_id`; the next calls use them. **Run a single request alone:** run **Collect first IDs (optional) / Collect first IDs (all lists)** once (after a login), or any List request: they save the id of the first row in the variable of each model. Get one, Update and Delete requests also fill an empty variable themselves from the first row of their list. Careful: a Delete request with such an id deletes a real row. For a full run with the Collection Runner: set `skip_deletes` to `true` (the Delete calls of the model folders are skipped), run the app folders in the order shown, then run the folder **Cleanup (optional)**, which deletes everything in the right order. The Upload CSV, Upload track and Upload photo calls need a file chosen in their body.

**Not covered:** WebSocket requests (see management / ws for the ticket and the URLs).
